question: What is the essence of all this, and what counts as the world?
premises: ocean-ness is movement in which waves are not two
the essence of all of this is consciousness
the inert is what stands as the world
inference: consciousness alone is the essence of everything, the inert is only the world
uncertainties: yaccitsāraṃ segmentation uncertain between yat, cit and sāra
plain_english: Ocean-ness is a movement where waves are never two; the essence of all this is consciousness, while the inert is only the world.
